config.dimensionless: lam_hat = lambda d_min^2 / c^2, dt_hat = dt c / d_min, c = sqrt(E/rho)
config.residual_definition: eta = ||B y - lambda y||_2 / (|lambda| ||y||_2), B = M^-1/2 K M^-1/2

meta.solver_schedule: Lanczos (full reorth, 2 start vectors), dense check n≤3000, bounds (Gershgorin, Collatz–Wielandt, cell splitting, Sylvester/Cholesky), shift-invert low modes

alpha_decision.rule: smallest α with support_ratio ≤ 1.1 and θ1/θ1(free) ≤ 1.1 in every development case; else 0.5

contract.statement: asset valid iff RSA spacing ≥ d_min, generator–support distance ≥ α d_min, Voronoi consistent, and every cell Û_i ≤ κ² (Û = U d_min²/c²)

posthoc.note: added after the pre-registered runs; not used to fix α or κ
